The '''Forward Commander Carbine''' was a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine weapon]] used by the [[Forward Commander Mk II]], one of [[HK-47]]'s [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. It closely resembled the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Bola carbine/Legends|Bola carbine]].
